methodology: Loaded July 9 page contexts and per-symbol snapshots, then compared against June 23 verdict files where available.

Prioritized top-30 ranks and >=10% movers; deltas combine directness to the page thesis, post-refresh price action, YTD crowding, market-cap/visibility caps, and fresh web evidence for HBM/CPO/advanced-packaging developments.

Primary-source preference was applied where readily available through IR/SEC links; category web checks were used for CPO/NPO and HBM capacity evidence when individual July filings were not present in local context.
No live page CSV/TS data was modified; this pass only wrote verdict JSON and this report.

CPO/NPO adoption remains structurally valid, but the optical/connectivity basket is now crowded and volatile; several strong businesses deserve lower alpha ranks rather than thesis removals.

blockers: Full manual web research for every one of the 220 page rows was not feasible in one pass; for lower-priority names without local July news, verdicts rely on the provided July context, price-action snapshots, prior verdicts, and category-level web evidence.

Some foreign listings use alternate tickers between pages and per-symbol files; outputs use the best available canonical symbol context when matched by page/rank/company, otherwise the displayed market symbol.
